instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Biotech company developing novel monoclonal antibody therapies for autoimmune diseases. Lead candidate in Phase II clinical trials for rheumatoid arthritis with promising biomarker data. The 65-person R&D team focuses heavily on translational science and early-stage pipeline development. Key innovation need is AI-accelerated candidate screening using in-silico protein folding and binding affinity prediction to streamline preclinical selection.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration within the core R&D function. However, adjacent teams like manufacturing and regulatory affairs are still adapting their communication protocols to this faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Forge has recently secured a smaller grant focusing on oncology-related mechanisms which presents an immediate opportunity for pipeline diversification. The company is currently struggling to hire specialized bioinformaticians needed for the proposed AI initiatives.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Process Optimization of Clinical Data Handling
opportunities.rationale: Implement targeted AI modules for optimizing existing lab workflows and early preclinical data analysis to improve efficiency without major structural changes.

first_actions: Pilot integration of machine learning models in current biomarker screening pipeline.
Conduct a 3-month internal audit of R&D time allocation vs. output.
resources_needed: Software licensing for cloud computing services
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of preclinical screening cycle time by 20% within 6 months.
milestones: M1: Pilot ML model deployment complete
M2: Operational integration into Q3 workflow

opportunities.title: Strategic Pivot to Adjacent Therapeutic Modality Partnership
opportunities.rationale: Invest in a low-cost, short-term partnership or spin-off project exploring an entirely new therapeutic area (e.g., rare autoimmune subset) to de-risk the pipeline concentration.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated 'Blue Sky' task force within R&D.
Identify 3 potential academic or biotech partners in an adjacent market.
execution_plan.success_metric: Execution of a formal LOI with at least one non-core partner by end of Q4.
milestones: M1: Task force charter and preliminary market analysis
M2: Signed MOU/LOI with 1 strategic partner

next_steps.action: Formalize a 6-month roadmap prioritizing both incremental efficiency gains and radical diversification exploration.
Conduct an external assessment focused specifically on talent acquisition strategy to mitigate the primary barrier of 'talent'.
Develop a detailed business case for one low-risk, high-learning adjacent market partnership.

key_weaknesses: Limited budget (3%) severely restricts funding for long-term R&D infrastructure and large scale hiring.
High dependence on a single product category, creating significant revenue concentration risk.
Bottleneck in talent acquisition, specifically specialized computational biology skills needed for AI initiatives.
Partial innovation process means lack of standardized pathways for new idea generation outside of existing sprint cycles.
